environments.name: dev
environments.identitySource: deployment metadata resolved server-side; a caller-supplied stage is only a request checked against it

fixtureIdentity.description: Reserved fixture ids and reserved persona principals; anything else in a fixture-owned entity belongs to someone real.

entities.reason: Notes the note-authoring flow creates; the flow deletes them only on its happy path, so the reset owns the survivors.
entities.ownership: rows authored by a reserved persona and older than the in-flight window

entities.reason: Ingested catalog; no seed in this repository can restore it, so it is never a reset target.
entities.enforcedBy: reset role holds SELECT only on the catalog schema

entities.reason: Recomputed from the catalog and fixture rows; neither cleared nor preserved.
Money ledger; irreversible and never a reset target under any environment.
entities.enforcedBy: reset role has no grant on the ledger schema; grant revoked, not merely unused

entities.reason: Throwaway accounts registered by sign-up flows; rows are not the only kind of state.
entities.ownership: accounts whose identifier matches the reserved persona address shape

entities.reason: Files uploaded by the attachment flow under a reserved prefix.
entities.ownership: objects under the reserved e2e prefix only

preserves-non-fixture-data.evidence: demo: reset/preserve.test — catalog counts unchanged across a reset

rejects-reserved-id-collision.evidence: demo: reset/identity.test — reserved id colliding with a real row aborts

rejects-foreign-references.evidence: demo: reset/references.test — fixture row referencing a preserved row is refused, not cascaded

requires-write-acknowledgment.evidence: demo: reset/acknowledgment.test — unacknowledged mutation reported as failure

converges-on-second-apply.evidence: demo: reset/converge.test — second apply reports zero further change

verifies-exact-counts.evidence: demo: reset/verify.test — exact per-entity counts, never 'at least one'

production-fails-closed.evidence: demo: reset/guard.test — every production alias refused with transport never invoked

guard-at-the-choke-point.evidence: demo: reset/guard.test — the guard runs immediately before every outbound mutation

enumerates-before-mutating.evidence: demo: reset/dry-run.test — unknown ownership blocks the run
